text:
2018 FIFA World Cup a wɔyɛe wɔ Russia fi 14 June kɔsi 15 July no yɛ edi a edi kan a wɔyɛe wɔ Russia na ɛyɛ nea edi kan a wɔde too Eastern Europe. Nteam 32 wɔn de too nkuo 8 a ɛwɔ nteam 4 biara mu, na group stage no de kɔɔ single-elimination knockout bracket a ɛwɔ round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off ne final, matches 64 nyinaa. Ɛyɛ World Cup a edi kan a wɔde Video Assistant Referee anaa VAR system no dii dwuma, na ɛkyerɛ technological turning point ma tournament no. Nnipa bɛboro 3 million na wɔkɔɔ matches 64 no nyinaa, average bɛyɛ 47,000 per game.

Group stage no de shock a ɛbɛyɛɛ early no baeɛ bere a defending champion Germany wɔn kɔɔ mu, ɛyɛ ne World Cup exit a ɛdi kan sen 1938. Knockout rounds no mu nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ no yɛ Croatia, ɔman ketewa no kɔɔ ne World Cup final a edi kan wɔ run a midfielder Luka Modrić na ɔanchor. France kɔɔ anim kɔhyiaa wɔn wɔ Moscow's Luzhniki Stadium wɔ 15 July.

Wɔ final no mu no, France dii Croatia 4–2 so de too ne World Cup title a ɛdi abien, akyiri 1998, na ɛgyaa Croatia sɛ runner-up wɔ ne final appearance a edi kan no mu. Wɔ French scorers no mu na Kylian Mbappé wɔ hɔ, a wɔn 19 no ɔbɛyɛɛ teenager a odi kan a ɔscoor wɔ World Cup final mu sen Pelé wɔ 1958 na wɔfrɛɛ no Best Young Player. Nkunim no nso kyerɛ sɛ France bɛyɛɛ European nation a ɛto so anan a ɛtrɛɛ continent no run a ɛwɔ World Cup titles a ɛdi ahanan a ɛto so, a ɛdi akyiri European winners a 2006, 2010 ne 2014.

Individual honours no mu no, England’s Harry Kane dii top scorer so wɔ goals 6, na Luka Modrić nyaa Golden Ball sɛ tournament no mu ɔbɔfo a ɔyɛ yie. Wɔ third-place play-off no mu no, Belgium dii England so de too third place, na Belgium goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois nyaa Golden Glove.
